summary: Aardvark Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose that the FDA placed a full clinical hold on its IND for ARD-101 following a voluntary pause. The hold covers the Phase 3 HERO trial and open-label extension for Prader-Willi Syndrome. No terms, price, premium, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are present. The company intends to unblind data to inform a path forward. This is a regulatory event, not a special-situation transaction; it does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes.
